model.name: One trunk, CI-gated merges, CI-made tags
model.description: main is an orphan history (root c7924287f, 2026-08-29, v0.8.139) while prod runs hotfix/t40.1-checklist-band (v0.8.247). All 483 tags live only on the hotfix line, there was no CI and almost no merges: agents committed and tagged directly. Target: main = what prod runs, changes arrive only as PRs, CI must be green to merge, and only CI creates a release tag.
model.poDirective: Tron 2026-11-22: radical consolidation of test users and CI, run by a separate Claude Code agent (not the oopTeam fleet).

acceptanceCriteria.text: git merge-base main <prod commit> equals the prod commit.

gateRef.assertion: compare main HEAD with the deployed version

acceptanceCriteria.text: main is protected: PR required, CI required, no force-push.

gateRef.assertion: a direct push to main is rejected

acceptanceCriteria.text: Tags are created by CI on the merge commit after the version bump; nobody tags by hand.

gateRef.assertion: the next release tag's creator is the CI workflow
